transcription: Open a display window, show the elevation map with a legend, a north arrow, a scale bar, wait 3 seconds, then close the display.
answer: Plan: open a wx0 display monitor, draw elevation@PERMANENT with d.rast, add d.legend, d.northarrow and d.barscale, wait 3 seconds, then stop the monitor with d.mon stop=wx0. Needs a graphical display (X/Wayland) to open the window; if none is available the d.mon step will fail.

plan.purpose: Open the wxGUI display window that the other d.* commands draw into.
Draw the elevation raster (elevation@PERMANENT) in the display.
Add a colour legend for the elevation map.
Add a north arrow to the map.
Add a scale bar to the map.
Keep the display open for 3 seconds.
Close the display window and release the monitor.
